groups.title: The Serverless Model
groups.question: Explain what serverless compute is and how it changes the way you design an application.

followUps.Function-as-a-Service vs Traditional Com: Which constraints of serverless functions push you toward a different design than you would use on a VM or container?
followUps.AWS Lambda Execution Model and Cold Star: Where should you create SDK clients and database connections in a Lambda function, and why does that placement matter?

groups.title: IAM and Security Basics
groups.question: Walk through how a Lambda function gets permission to do things in AWS and who is allowed to call it.

followUps.Lambda Execution Roles and Least Privile: What could an attacker do if a function with a very broad role were compromised, and how do you scope the role instead?
followUps.Resource-Based vs Identity-Based Policie: When an S3 bucket fails to trigger your function with AccessDenied, which policy do you check and why?

groups.title: Triggers and Event Sources
groups.question: Explain the different ways events can reach a Lambda function and how that affects error handling.

followUps.Synchronous vs Asynchronous Invocation: How does error handling differ when API Gateway calls your function versus when SNS calls it?
followUps.Event Source Mapping for Streams and Que: What goes wrong when one record in an SQS or Kinesis batch keeps failing, and how do you stop it?

groups.title: Observability from Day One
groups.question: Explain how you would know whether a new Lambda function is healthy and what it costs from the first day.

followUps.CloudWatch Logs and Lambda Metrics: Which built-in Lambda metrics would you put alarms on first, and what problem does each one reveal?
followUps.Lambda Pricing Model and Cost Awareness: Why does raising a function's memory setting change its cost, and when can a busy function cost more than a server?
